name: Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo 人物角色替换
description: Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo 人物角色替换：上传原图与人物参考图，将原图中的人物替换为参考图中的人物，迁移其五官、发型与身份特征，同时保持原图的姿势、服装、动作、机位、构图、背景与光影不变。适合换人出镜、IP 角色植入、合照换人等场景。

ui_schema.name: image
ui_schema.label: 原图
ui_schema.description: 被替换人物所在的原始图片，场景、姿势与构图将保持不变

ui_schema.name: character_image
ui_schema.label: 替换的人物
ui_schema.description: 提供五官、发型与身份特征的人物参考图

ui_schema.name: positive
ui_schema.label: 替换指令
ui_schema.default: character_swap: use <image1> as the base image and <image2> as the character identity reference. Replace the person in <image1> with the person from <image2>, transferring their facial features, hairstyle, and identity. Preserve the original pose, body position, clothing, action, camera angle, composition, background, lighting, and environment of <image1>. Make the replacement look natural and seamlessly integrated into the original scene. Do not alter any other elements. High detail, realistic anatomy, sharp focus.
ui_schema.placeholder: 默认角色替换指令，一般无需修改
ui_schema.description: 默认将原图（image1）中的人物替换为参考图（image2）中的人物，并保持场景不变；可用 <image1>/<image2> 指代两张图来自定义指令
